content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've read many examples and forum threads, and following guidance from [url], I understand how to modify weekly timer parameters using [product_name] operator device. However, it seems the same method doesn't apply to the [product_name] web server. For instance, pressing ESC for 3 seconds has no effect. Does anyone have suggestions? I need to adjust the weekdays and on-time settings for all three cameras. [user_name]
The web server doesn't support pressing the ESC button. Instead, try double-clicking the corresponding field. This should open a window where you can edit the parameters.
Thank you. That was an unexpectedly simple solution! [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users found it challenging to adjust weekly timer settings via the [product_name] web server, expecting input methods consistent with [product_name] operator devices. The lack of direct interaction—such as holding the ESC button—caused some initial confusion. However, once users tried double-clicking the relevant field, they discovered it was an easy and effective way to change parameters. This highlights a usability gap between traditional hardware button controls and web-based interfaces.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to change weekly timer parameters intuitively through the [product_name] web server, ideally using interface actions they recognize from [product_name] operator devices—like pressing the ESC button—or another equally straightforward method.
